audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1 and 3 were backwards in both layers. The page gave Gangplank Level 1 at 7/10 and Gwen Level 3 at 4/10; the mirror (gwen__gangplank) corrected the chart to Gwen / Skill / Gangplank / Gwen / Gangplank / Gwen / Gwen.
audit.why: Our own prose already disagreed with the chart: whys[0] and early call levels 1-3 hers and say level 1 is 'your worst stretch of the lane', while level 3 is where the second keg point and Parrrley range start paying. The mirror reached the same conclusion from Gwen's side, so both directions now agree.
audit.corrected: phases[0] Gangplank 7/10 -> Gwen 4/10 and phases[2] Gwen 4/10 -> Gangplank 7/10, with win[0] and win[2] flipped to match. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] sits in the Level 3 row but described Cannon Barrage carpeting her mist — a level 6 spike. The row therefore justified the wrong stage entirely.
audit.why: At level 3 what actually changes is that the keg chain is online and Parrrley reaches 625, comfortably outside Snip Snip!'s 450 cone and Skip 'n Slash's 400 dash. Cannon Barrage's window is already covered by whys[4] and spikes[1].
audit.corrected: whys[2] rewritten around the 625 / 450 / 400 range gap that makes level 3 yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Snip Snip! was written 'Snip Snip' and A Thousand Cuts as 'Thousand Cuts'. More substantively, Snip Snip! was described as true-damaging 'your HP bar' outright — Riot's text is that it deals magic damage in a cone and true damage only to units in the CENTER of that cone.
audit.why: The centre-only detail is the whole reason spacing works against her Q: standing at the edge of the cone converts the true damage into magic damage your MR actually resists. Writing it as blanket true damage tells the player their MR is worthless, which is only true if they let her line them up.
audit.corrected: Names fixed in spikes[0] and wants.foe[1]; spikes[0] now states the centre restriction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes A Thousand Cuts out-sustaining your damage but never says to buy Grievous Wounds, even though the full layer's itemization already calls anti-heal core.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the on-hit damage she deals to champions — a poke-based win condition leaks to it continuously, so the anti-heal timing is what decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: late now ties her sustain to buying Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage carpets her mist tile — the AoE forces her out of the cloud while your kegs and artillery zone her off farm and Grubs; your cleanest, only-clear stage.
edits.after: Your keg chain is fully online at 3 and Parrrley detonates it from 625 — outside her 450 Snip Snip! and her 400 dash — so she pays HP to farm; your cleanest early stage.

edits.before: Skip 'n Slash (E) dashes her onto you with empowered, attack-speed autos while Snip Snip (Q) true-damages your HP bar; she just stands in Hallowed Mist (W) so your Parrrley and keg detonation hit the cloud, not her.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash (E) dashes her onto you with empowered, attack-speed autos while Snip Snip! (Q) true-damages the cone's centre; she just stands in Hallowed Mist (W) so your Parrrley and keg detonation hit the cloud, not her.

edits.before: Snip Snip with Q true damage and Skip 'n Slash resets to shred your HP and heal off Thousand Cuts regardless of your resists
edits.after: Snip Snip! with Q true damage and Skip 'n Slash resets to shred your HP and heal off A Thousand Cuts regardless of your resists

edits.before: This is where you lose if it goes long. Gwen is a hard scaler: two items deep her Q true damage cuts through every point of MR you bought, her Thousand-Cuts healing out-sustains your Trial-by-Fire DoT, Skip 'n Slash resets let her dance in and out of your barrel zone, and Hallowed Mist eats your one big keg-chain burst every fight. Your job is to have already converted the Level 6 and first-item windows into a side-lane lead you can pressure with Cannon Barrage. If it's even at three items, don't duel her over a barrel she can just mist or E through — group, use R to swing other fights globally, and let your team collapse on her instead of soloing the scaler.
edits.after: This is where you lose if it goes long. Gwen is a hard scaler: two items deep her Q cuts true damage through your MR whenever she centres the cone on you, A Thousand Cuts heals her off every on-hit unless Grievous Wounds is already bought, Skip 'n Slash resets let her dance in and out of your barrel zone, and Hallowed Mist eats your one big keg-chain burst every fight. Your job is to have already converted the Level 6 and first-item windows into a side-lane lead you can pressure with Cannon Barrage. If it's even at three items, don't duel her over a barrel she can just mist or E through — group, use R to swing other fights globally, and let your team collapse on her instead of soloing the scaler.

notes: The level chart was inverted at levels 1 and 3 relative to both the mirror and this page's own prose — fixed as one atomic group across both layers. The Level 3 'why' had been written about Cannon Barrage, a level 6 tool, which is why the row looked wrong in the first place. Note that whys[4] and spikes[1] both cover the level 6 mist-flush window, so nothing was lost by retargeting whys[2]. One thing I could not settle from the kit: Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable to enemies outside the mist, but whether a Powder Keg detonation's area damage still catches her inside it (area damage rather than a targeted hit) is not answerable from Riot's text, so I left every 'your detonation hits the cloud, not her' claim exactly as inherited rather than strengthening or weakening it.
